events.name: Mark Thomas: 40 in Stand-Up Years
events.description: Mark Thomas celebrates 40 years at the microphone with a new stand-up show looking back at four decades of comedy, campaigning and political mischief.

events.name: Wuthering Heights (2026) – Cardington Village Hall
events.description: Arts Alive screening of Wuthering Heights (2026), certification 15, at Cardington Village Hall. The official programme confirms Wednesday 4 November at 19:30, tickets £5.

events.name: Jazz Emu: The Pleasure Is All Yours
events.description: Jazz Emu brings the new musical-comedy show The Pleasure Is All Yours to Theatre Severn. The direct promoter confirms a 19:30 local start; no end time has been stored because secondary listings disagree on it.

events.name: Shaping Colour – Gilly Hemmer
events.description: A solo exhibition by Gilly Hemmer, working mainly in acrylics across still life, little houses and landscapes in a naïve and abstract style. The venue confirms the exhibition runs 16 October–28 November 2026; no daily opening time has been invented.

events.name: The Nutcracker – Imperial Classical Ballet
events.description: Imperial Classical Ballet presents The Nutcracker at Theatre Severn. The production company confirms a 19:30 local start on Thursday 8 October 2026; no unconfirmed end time or price has been added.

events.name: Pink Floyd’s Wish You Were Here & Dark Side of the Moon – Everything Under The Sun
events.description: Everything Under The Sun perform Pink Floyd’s Wish You Were Here and The Dark Side of the Moon in full, using Shrewsbury Abbey’s pipe organ alongside a seven-piece band, synchronised lasers and video. Doors 18:30; show 19:30–22:00 local.

events.name: Blood Pressure Check Up Pop-Up
events.description: Free drop-in blood-pressure checks with a complimentary cuppa at The Wakes, Theatre Square, Oakengates. No appointment is needed.

events.name: Come From Away – Shrewsbury Musical Theatre Company
events.description: Shrewsbury Musical Theatre Company presents Come From Away at Theatre Severn. Confirmed performances: Thu 15 Oct 2026 at 7:30pm; Fri 16 Oct at 7:30pm; Sat 17 Oct at 2:00pm and 7:00pm. Tickets from £22.50.

events.name: Exotic Boo at the Zoo – Halloween Half Term
events.description: Halloween half-term at Exotic Zoo, running daily 24 October–1 November 2026, 11am–4pm. General admission includes the themed Haunted Woods, Halloween photo opportunities, Creepy Crawly Cave, Creepy Café, face painting, pumpkin picking, bush-tucker trials and the usual animal encounters. This Events record uses the first occurrence; the daily recurrence through 1 November is preserved here and in the discovery notes.
events.accessibility: Zoo states step-free access via ramps to major pathways/exhibits, accessible toilets, designated accessible parking and seating. The Woodland Walk has uneven natural surfaces/gradients and is not recommended for wheelchair users or those needing step-free access. Sensory considerations include animal sounds, smells, changing lighting and busy periods; selected Quiet Hours are offered separately.
events.parking_transport: Main entrance car park is Dark Lane Car Park, Hinkshay Road, TF4 3GZ. Accessible parking is available near the entrance; Blue Badge holders park free. Telford Central is the nearest station, with bus/walking links through the town centre and Town Park.
events.age_guidance: Family-friendly; no specific age limit stated

events.name: Telford Town Park Dark Run 2026
events.description: Family-friendly Hope House charity Dark Run at Telford Town Park: choose a 5K route or 2.5K for little legs. Event starts 6pm, warm-up 6:10pm and run starts 6:30pm; official Hope House event metadata lists an end time of 9pm. Adults £15, under-16s £10; under-3s are free but do not receive a goody bag or medal. Every child entrant must be accompanied by a participating paying adult, up to three children per adult. Registration from 5:30pm. No dogs; bring a head torch/flashlight.
events.age_guidance: Under-16s must be accompanied by a participating paying adult; under-3s free

events.name: Wem Library Rhyme Time – 24 September
events.description: Free songs and rhymes for under-5s at Wem Library. No booking required; just turn up. Official council schedule also confirms 1, 8, 15 and 22 October, then 5, 12, 19 and 26 November 2026, each 2:15–2:45pm. No 29 October session is currently listed.

events.name: Home Educators: Prehistoric Potters
events.description: Hands-on prehistoric pottery workshop for home-educated children aged 5–11. Children explore prehistoric pots and make/decorate their own clay pot. This is a supervised drop-off session; parents/carers do not stay. £7.50 per child.
events.accessibility: Museum has level-ground entry, lifts to all floors including the second-floor Education Room, accessible toilets on each floor, seating, assistance dogs welcome, and a hearing induction loop available by prior arrangement.
events.parking_transport: No general onsite parking. Nearest listed option is Raven Meadows multi-storey, about 450m away. Shrewsbury Park & Ride stops on High Street around 130m from the museum.

events.name: Clun Ukulele Band
events.description: Clun Ukulele Band at Clun Memorial Hall, confirmed by the venue for Saturday 24 October from 2pm to 4pm.

events.name: 50 Years of Rotary Training at RAF Shawbury – Celebratory March-Past
events.venue: Market Drayton town centre – Frogmore Rd, Queen St, Cheshire St to the Library
events.description: Celebratory March-Past marking 50 years of rotary training at RAF Shawbury, with a helicopter flypast from 1FTS. The public are invited to line the route through Market Drayton.

events.name: Little Stars Halloween Charity Ball 2026
events.description: Little Stars Charity's Halloween Charity Ball returns with a vintage spooky carnival theme, fine dining, live music and entertainment. Black tie. Standard tickets £65 per person; VIP tickets £80 per person. Proceeds support Little Stars' work with children and families across Shropshire and Telford & Wrekin.

events.name: The Devine Musick Piano Trio
events.description: Shropshire Music Trust concert featuring Haydn's Piano Trio in E major, Mozart's Piano Trio in G major and Beethoven's Piano Trio in E-flat major. Tickets £19; children and full-time students £9.

events.name: Red Priest – A Baroque Extravaganza
events.description: Red Priest present a Baroque Extravaganza featuring Vivaldi's Four Seasons alongside works by Bach, Handel and Telemann. Tickets £23; children and full-time students £11.
